concurrency: Single-threaded per run; one admission attempt per run root; no shared mutable state and no background work.
dependencies: accepted xverse_xdl.experiment_plan public API/digest semantics (read-only, unchanged)
accepted C++ X-COM observation contract 1.0.0 (read-only, unchanged)
deployment: Offline, in-process Python library and console entry point inside the admitted ARGUS2 envelope: no process, service, container, network, device, provider handle, live tap, registry or oracle is created, started, probed or contacted.
rationale: Source allocation from docs/engineering/argus-lite/requirements.md ARGUS2-SR-001, realized by ARGUS2-ARCH-01/ARGUS2-ARCH-05 in docs/engineering/argus-lite/architecture.md section 4 and frozen in docs/engineering/argus-lite/detailed-design.md.
responsibilities: Verify the supplied resolved plan through the accepted xverse_xdl.experiment_plan public API; reject a recorded/recomputed body-digest mismatch.
Record the accepted API/Profile/plan versions and the verified semantic plan digest in the manifest plan block.
Keep source-byte provenance in a separate map and never substitute it for the semantic plan identity.
Reject an unsupported plan/Profile/API major version, an envelope identity conflicting with the declared run identity, and an already-existing run root before creating or overwriting anything.
Open exactly one fresh run bound to the caller-supplied unique run identity.
state_ownership: Owns the run-admission decision and the in-memory plan-identity record. Holds no durable state before a successful open; creates only the exclusive run root and its manifest at open.
title: ARGUS2-SR-001-CMP allocation - Run admission and verified plan binding
